about: Where each Vault part goes, per unit, measured from the STL files (tools/placements). Each part: [path in the Vault download, colour role, group, 3x4 row-major matrix]. The matrix maps the file's own coordinates to the unit frame: three.js axes, +X right seen from the front, +Y up, +Z towards the viewer, mm, origin at the middle of the module's front bottom edge. group 'drawer' parts slide out along +Z when the drawer opens.

stack.note: a module's underside rests on the top face of the one below: the next unit starts first + per_level * (levels - 1) above the bottom of the one below (measured on L7)

case.note: a case (sustainer) is its body plus a lid that comes down 6.9 mm over it; the next unit starts body height + 15.6 above the case's bottom (push fits on S3 1F, corrected by the same fit run on two drawer modules). R.exterior says 65.5 / 99.5 / 195.5.
